name: Myna Nandhini
bio: Myna Nandhini is an Indian actress, She also works in the Tamil film and television industry.

credits.title: Thalaivan Thalaivii
credits.overview: Two headstrong lovers navigate a turbulent relationship where passion and conflict intertwine, creating an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.
